speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Second, we will need to take into account other sentencing considerations.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Such offences cause great distress to victims and threaten public safety.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: As such, punishment, deterrence and public protection are key considerations in sentencing for such offences.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Can I just check the timeline for the review?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: And two, I understand that, currently, programmes under the Reformative Training (RT) regimes have already been modified for the intellectually disabled inmates.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: But I think the limiting factor is the prison officer's time as well as resource constraint.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: Generally, the prison service takes extra precautions to manage inmates who are diagnosed with intellectual disability.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: Those with mental illnesses and who require treatment are currently housed separately at the psychiatric housing unit.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: And those who are able to assimilate with the mainstream population and are housed with them, they generally undergo the same rehabilitation programmes like other inmates.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: However, prison staff will monitor them closely to pick up any incidents of bullying or difficulties in adjustment.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: But the concern really is that they are saying they do not have enough time and resources.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: So, I am just wondering whether on the Ministry of Home Affairs' side we can pump in more resources so that the RT officers can have time to modify programmes for the intellectually disabled.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: I think the time and resources issue will be considered as part of the general review and we will certainly be keen to ensure that our inmates get the proper support to help with their rehabilitation process.
